# kcore_cluster_update (Resource)

Host OS rollout (`kctl update cluster`). Destroy cancels the rollout. Reboot stays a kctl command.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_cluster_update" "os" {
  name                    = "release-0-5-0"
  version                 = "0.5.0"
  flake_ref               = "github:kcorehypervisor/kcore"
  flake_rev               = "b7da7c99f385fec391d0a9fb975fe4791d06ae94"
  nixpkgs_rev             = "b40629efe5d6ec48dd1efba650c797ddbd39ace0"
  all_nodes               = true
  strategy                = "one-at-a-time"
  max_unavailable         = 1
  batch_size              = 1
  activation              = "auto"
  update_kind             = "kcore"
  schema_version          = 59
  previous_schema_version = 56
  min_compatible_reader   = 56
  approval                = "manual"
  approve                 = false

  tested_os_pins {
    nixpkgs_rev        = "b40629efe5d6ec48dd1efba650c797ddbd39ace0"
    ceph_rev           = "e7439b6b14ad3cc35d05608ebca9bce01a25f5f8"
    ceph_sha256        = "19y4py973w62z4qb7gzn0chjs67ihxy8rbjb7g71iyk8yz7z5k8z"
    kubernetes_version = "1.37.0"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flake_ref` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `version` (String)

### Optional

- `activation` (String) test, switch, boot, or auto. Reboot stays `kctl update cluster reboot`.
- `all_nodes` (Boolean)
- `approval` (String)
- `approve` (Boolean) Call approve after create when approval is manual.
- `batch_size` (Number)
- `controllers_only` (Boolean)
- `drain_vms` (Boolean)
- `flake_rev` (String)
- `labels` (List of String)
- `max_unavailable` (Number) Defaults to 1.
- `min_compatible_reader` (Number)
- `nixpkgs_rev` (String)
- `node_ids` (List of String)
- `previous_schema_version` (Number)
- `requires_nixpkgs` (Boolean)
- `schema_version` (Number)
- `strategy` (String) one-at-a-time. The 0.5.0 controller refuses canary, batch, and per-dc.
- `system_profile` (String)
- `tested_os_pins` (Block List) Pins from the kcore release manifest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tested_os_pins))
- `update_kind` (String) `kcore` or `nixpkgs`. Defaults to `kcore`.

### Read-Only

- `approval_status` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `phase` (String)
